title: Diffle hover playground
description: A local schema for trying configuration tooltips without downloading a schema.

name.description: A human-readable name for this deployment. Shown in the deployment dashboard.

environment.description: The target environment: development for local experiments, staging for pre-release checks, or production for live traffic.

enabled.description: Whether this deployment accepts new jobs. Disable it to pause processing without losing queued work.

runner.description: Settings for the machine that executes each job.

runs-on.description: The operating system used to execute jobs. Try hovering directly over the hyphen in this key.

timeout-seconds.description: Maximum runtime in seconds before a job is cancelled. The default is 30 seconds.

tags.description: Labels attached to each job for filtering and reporting.

retries.description: How many times a failed job is retried (0–5). This description comes through a schema $ref.
